name: M1 Long — Confluence Model

Gap-down quiet morning bounce: long FVGC 9:30-9:45 when overnight gap-down + no pre-RTH news + vixy_normal + variant_no_fvg + calendar factors align. 7-pro / 2-veto stack passes all 5 acceptance gates (year-floor 50%, regime spread 9.4pp, IS/OOS delta 4.8pp, n=117 over 8yr). The bullish counterpart to M1 Short — same window, opposite setup logic (fade gap-down vs continuation on gap-down panic).
pre_market_conditions: Hard vetoes (skip entirely): prior day closed bottom 1/3 (prior_day_weak). Pre-market confluences (check by 9:25): no pre-RTH news scheduled (+21.1pp), prior day closed in middle 1/3 (33-67%, +9.5pp), VIXY in normal regime (+6.6pp), IS FOMC week (+6.3pp), day=Wednesday (+6.3pp), gap < -100 pts (gap_large_down, +5.5pp). NOT FOMC week is NOT a confluence here — the play wants FOMC-week Wednesdays.
action_plan:
At 9:31 check 9:30 candle body — if top quartile, skip (veto, c930_body_top_q -5.5pp). At signal fire (9:30-9:45), require variant_no_fvg for cleanest setup (+8.0pp). Total 3+ confluences → take full size with BE@1R → TP@3R. Do not scale up at 4+ tier (OOS n=1).

Exit Strategy: BE@1R → 3R fixed target. EV +0.54R/trade, PF 2.31. Standard size at 3+ tier (do NOT scale up at 4+ — n thin OOS).

Was Tier B; upgraded to Tier A based on multi_cell_8yr_v2 study (2026-05-18) which showed the OLD compression-thesis stack misidentified the play — true edge is calendar (Mon/Fri) + prior_day_weak + variant_no_fvg.

Vetoes: opex week, day=Tuesday. Take FVGC long signal 10:00-10:15 at 3+ confluence, full size; do NOT add size at 4+/5+ tier (OOS-collapses).

name: M3 Short — Both-Swept Carve-Out (Idea)
description: Carve-out to the standard 'no shorts in M3' rule. When BOTH OR.H and OR.L have been swept (any wick beyond) by 10:00 ET, the day is in expanded-range/trending mode and short FVGCs targeting OR.L re-test work. n=39 across Oct 2023 – Mar 2026, no OOS split. Best opposite-direction M3 cell across all 4 sweep states.
pre_market_conditions: None specific. Trigger is intraday only — sweep state at 10:00 ET.
action_plan:
At 10:00 ET, BOTH OR.H AND OR.L must have wicked through (loose definition: any high > OR.H AND any low < OR.L between 9:45 and 10:00). Short FVGC entry in the M3 window (10:00–10:15). Standard FVGC variant rules — not BOS, not protected_swing.

Exit Strategy: TP at OR.L touch (re-test). SL per FVGC model. 71.4% of trades reach OR.L. No BE management studied yet.
frequency: ~13% of days have both OR sides swept by 10:00. Conservative estimate: 2–3 setups/month at most.

name: W1 Short — Post-Sweep Continuation
description: FVGC short in W1 (9:30–9:45) when the nearest unswept bullish 15m FVG below entry has ALREADY been touched by price between 9:30 and entry (htf_fvg_15m_swept = 'in_session'). The 15m FVG below acts as a magnet/reaction zone — when price taps it before your entry, the reactive zone is consumed and your trade has clean path down. 94.3% WR, median MFE 8.4R, PF 16+ at 1R. Highest-EV cell in the playbook for shorts.
pre_market_conditions: Identify any bullish 15m FVG below the likely entry zone. These are your potential 'magnets to be consumed'. The setup arms when price visits one of them in the first few minutes of RTH.
action_plan:
1) FVGC short signal fires in 9:30–9:45. 2) Pull up the 15m chart at entry: nearest unswept bullish 15m FVG below current price. 3) Has price touched it between 9:30 and now? If YES → take with full size + extended target. If NO → this play does not apply (fall back to W1 Short Confluence Model).

Exit Strategy: BE@1R then hold for 3R+ (EV +2.02R/trade). Aggressive runner: BE@1R, scale 1/3 at 3R, trail rest for 5R+ (EV +2.85R, higher variance). Do NOT cap at 1R — 89% reach 2R, 76% reach 3R, 64% reach 5R.
frequency: ~1.8 trades/month

name: Small-Gap Fade Long (9:31 Entry, Gap≥25pts)
description: Gap-down NQ >= 25 pts opens inside prior-day RTH range, small relative to ATR (|gap|/14d-ATR < 0.6). If the 9:30 1-min candle closes bullish, enter long at 9:31:00 open and fade to 50% of the gap. Stop 1.5x gap, time-stop 10:45. 80.4% WR / PF(pts) 3.61 / PF(R) 2.53 full-period across 46 trades (30s TF, 2023-10 → 2026-03). IS PF(R) is 1.80x — anchor live expectations there. Gap-floor derived from bucket analysis (tiny gaps <20pts were pure noise).
pre_market_conditions: Pull prior-day RTH high/low/close and 14d ATR of prior-day RTH range. At 9:30 open, compute gap = open - PDC. Play is LIVE only if: (1) gap is negative (gap-down), (2) |gap| >= 25 NQ points ← critical filter, (3) |gap|/ATR_14d < 0.6, (4) open is strictly inside prior-day RTH range (PDL < open < PDH).
action_plan:
9:30:00 → 9:30:59: watch the 9:30 1-minute candle. At 9:30:59, if it CLOSED BULLISH (close > open) → proceed. Any other outcome (bearish or doji) → skip.

Exit Strategy: Enter LONG at 9:31:00 open. TP = entry + 0.5 × |gap| (halfway to PDC). SL = entry − 1.5 × |gap|. Time-stop = 10:45 (close remaining at most recent close on/before 10:45).
frequency: ~1-2/month, ~20/year

name: Turtle Soup Short — Confluence Model
description: Short when price sweeps a resistance-side session level and closes back through on a 30s bar with a reversal confirmation candle. 5-factor additive confluence (prior_close_strong, gap_flat, mw_w3, depth_5_15pt, mss_confirmed). Score ≥ 3 required. Skip 0-2. 43 events over 30 months, 69.8% WR, PF 2.30.
pre_market_conditions: Prior day close position ≥ 0.70 (+1 prior_close_strong). Gap ≤ ±0.1% (+1 gap_flat). Lock in pre-market score 0-2.
action_plan:
Sweep of PDH/ONH/ORH/Asia/London/6am/BSL resistance level between 9:30-10:15 ET. 30s candle closes back through. Next candle confirms reversal (closes lower). At trigger count mw_w3 (10:00-10:15 window), depth_5_15pt (wick 5-15pt beyond level), mss_confirmed (break of recent 2-bar swing low).

Exit Strategy: Score 3: TP 1R baseline, trail to 2R on clean structure. Score 4+: move SL to BE at 1R, hold to 3R+ trailing behind 30s swing highs. Hard exit at 10:15 + 1hr or fixed TP, whichever first.
frequency: ~1.4/mo (43 events / 30 months)

name: IFVG Reversal — v3 (anchor-to-sweep + close entry)
wr_base: 71.0% @ 1R | 65.2% @ 1.5R | PF 2.81 (n=138 signals across 37 distinct opps — v3 re-run on TV-aligned bars)
pre_market_conditions: Mark: 1H swings (unswept), 4H swings (unswept), London H/L, Asia (overnight) H/L, 6am H/L, prior-day H/L/MID, NY AM rolling H/L (9:30 onward). On red-folder 8:30 news days, mark the 1-min news candle H/L if range ≥60pt. Primary confluence driver (re-run): instant_inversion=True (inversion happens within 1 bar of FVG formation, not 2) — WR 84.0% at n=50, +23.8pp lift. Secondary: large-bucket FVG sizes (bucket 6+, ~15pt+). Note: unlike the pre-fix run, swing_1H is NOT a significant confluence factor here.
action_plan:
LONG only. Killzone 9:30–11:00 ET. Entry TF: 3min (winner). Sweep (wick-through, wick_only strictness) of a major liquidity level. PD gate ON — entry must be below prior-day mid. Within 10 bars, a bearish 3-bar FVG forms whose NEAR EDGE (bottom) is anchored to the swept price: abs(fvg_bottom − sweep_price) ≤ 3 × fvg_size (no proximity cap). The sweep candle itself can be bar k of the 3-bar pattern. Entry = CLOSE of the first bar (within 2 bars of FVG formation) that closes back above the FVG top. No retest. Stop = FVG bottom − 5pt. Chop filter ON (skip if ≥3 bars sit inside the FVG before inversion). Obstruction filter ≤3.

Exit Strategy: 1.5R full close. PF 2.81 on this target (buffer=5pt on stop). WR@1R=71.0%, WR@1.5R=65.2%, avg_r=+0.630. Move stop to BE only after the first 10–20pt internal swing in profit — never tighter. Soft stop: full candle body close back through entry.
frequency: ~58 signals/yr (~15 distinct opps/yr)

name: 15m FVG Tap + Delivery Reversal
description: ⚠️ INVALIDATED — LOOK-AHEAD BIAS. Page was created from v1 study that had the same look-ahead bias (79% of trades used intraday 15m FVGs before they formed). pre_market_conditions: Open 15m chart. Mark all unmitigated 15m FVGs near current price. Note which side price is approaching from — bullish FVGs are support (reversal = long), bearish FVGs are resistance (reversal = short). Also mark draws: prior day H/L, 6am H/L, other 15m FVGs ahead.
action_plan:
Two-step sequence: (1) Price wicks into an unmitigated 15m FVG zone. The candle close does NOT violate the far boundary — the level holds and delivers price back. (2) First FVGC signal in the reversal direction fires within 20 bars. Long after tap into bullish FVG, Short after tap into bearish FVG. Any variant works.

Exit Strategy: BE@1R -> 2R. Move stop to breakeven at 1R, hold for 2R target. 82.3% of trades that hit 1R continue to 1.5R, 74.3% continue to 2R. Nearly doubles EV vs fixed 1R (+84%). MW1: hold to 2.5R. MW3: take 1.5R.
frequency: ~12/month (~2.8/week). Active on 59% of trading days.

name: 15m FVG Reversal (Sweep + Inversion)
description: ⚠️ INVALIDATED — LOOK-AHEAD BIAS. Original study used intraday 15m FVGs before they existed on the chart. When properly timing-gated, 70% of trades disappear and WR drops from 72.6% to 58.4% on n=77 with PF 1.32 (down from 3.40). Edge is borderline and sample is thin. See audit in studies/unified_reversal/audit_existing_plays.py. Do not trade this play.
pre_market_conditions: Identify unmitigated 15m FVGs near current price. These are the levels that will be swept. Mark them on the 15m chart.
action_plan:
Three-step sequence: (1) Price sweeps (wicks into) a 15m FVG — does NOT reclaim (closes through). (2) Within 10 bars (5 min), an opposing FVG inverts (close crosses its far boundary). (3) First FVGC signal in the reversal direction fires within 40 bars. Trade direction is OPPOSITE the sweep.

Exit Strategy: BE@1R → 1.5R. Move stop to breakeven at 1R, hold for 1.5R target. 85.6% of trades that hit 1R continue to 1.5R. Prefer W1 entries (70.4% hit rate at 1.5R).
frequency: ~4/month (~1/week). 15% of trading days.

name: ON Range Bias
description: FVGC entries with all 4 confluence factors produce 73.1% WR and 2.41+ PF (n=94, excl protected_swing). The model is binary — all 4 factors or skip. Factors: (A) ON level tested & bias confirmed, (B) VIXY high regime, (C) gap aligns with direction, (D) 9:30 candle aligns. W2 window (9:45-10:00) peaks at 79.1% WR, 3.76 PF. ON level test establishes directional bias; FVGC signal is the entry trigger.
pre_market_conditions: Check VIXY regime: must be 'high' — if not, no play today. Note gap direction from prior close. Check overnight range for high/low levels. 5 of 4 factors are knowable pre-market: VIXY high, gap aligned, ON high/low. Factor D (930 candle) is confirmed at 9:30:30. ON breakout state machine runs 9:30-10:15.
action_plan:
All 4 must be TRUE: (A) ON level tested & bias confirmed — watch 30s closes through ONH/ONL, wait for price to return within 5 pts of level then re-confirm direction. (B) VIXY high (≥25.2). (C) Gap aligns with direction. (D) 9:30 candle direction matches. Then take bos/ifvg/no_fvg only — skip protected_swing always. Prefer W1-W2 (before 10:00). W3 acceptable but lower PF.

Exit Strategy: 73.4% hit 1R, 59.6% hit 2R, 45.7% hit 3R. Edge decays past 3R. Recommended: BE@1R → 2R (W2 optimal). W1 entries: BE@1R → 2.5R (75% hit 2R, 62% hit 3R). W3: standard 1R or BE@1R → 2R.
frequency: ~3/month (clusters when VIXY is high regime; ~7 trades/month on active days)

name: VWAP Continuation
description: Anchored VWAP from 9:30, 3+ trend bars, pullback within 2pt, re-cross entry in gap-aligned direction, ONLY when R0 (entry-to-VWAP distance) ≥10 NQ pts. Exit: dynamic VWAP-close SL → BE at +1R → TP at +2.5R. 8yr revalidation 2018-2026: n=313, PF 4.61 raw / 4.13 after 0.5pt slip, EV +0.73R/trade (~$217/contract). Profitable every year incl. 2025 (+$19K/ct). Original 'Calm VIXY only' filter was wrong and has been removed — high-VIXY days actually have the highest PF.
pre_market_conditions: Skip day if: (1) red folder news on calendar, (2) Wednesday, (3) prior day type = reversal_up, (4) gap <2pt. Otherwise: gap-up → longs only; gap-down → shorts only. No VIXY filter (deprecated).
action_plan:
1. Session-anchored VWAP from 9:30. 2. Wait for 3+ consecutive 30s closes above (long) or below (short) VWAP. 3. Pullback within 2pt of VWAP. 4. Entry: first 30s close back on trend side. 5. CRITICAL: measure abs(entry - VWAP). If <10 NQ pts → skip this signal. 6. R0 = abs(entry - VWAP at entry). 7. No new entries after 10:00 ET. Multiple signals/day allowed.

Exit Strategy: Initial SL = first 30s close on wrong side of current VWAP (dynamic). Move stop to BE when +1R reached. TP = fixed +2.5R from entry. Three outcomes: WIN +2.5R (37%), BE 0R (47%), LOSS variable avg -1.3R (15%). PF 4.61 / EV +0.73R. The BE move at +1R is non-negotiable — without it, PF collapses to ~1.1.
frequency: ~3/month (0.75/week) — R0≥10pt tier

name: ATR Range Exhaustion Filter (High VIXY)
wr_base: 61% at 1R (high VIXY + <30% range used + W1, n=124) | 58-61% across window variants
description:
On high VIXY days, take FVGC entries at W1 (9:30–9:45) when <30–50% of the expected daily ATR range has already been used by session open. Expected daily range = 40-day rolling average of prior rth_range. Range used = (session_high – session_low) from 9:30 to entry bar / rolling_avg_rth_range.

This is a FILTER on top of the base FVGC model, not a standalone signal. It selects the subset of W1 FVGC trades that occur early in high-volatility sessions when most of the day's expected range still remains.
pre_market_conditions: Check VIXY regime: must be 'high'. Compute expected daily range = 40-day rolling avg of prior rth_range. This is your denominator for the range_used_pct filter during the session.
action_plan:
At FVGC entry signal: compute range_used_pct = (session_high_so_far – session_low_so_far) / rolling_40d_avg_rth_range. Only take the trade if range_used_pct < 30% (strict) or < 50% (looser). Entry must be W1 (9:30–9:45). Skip if >100% of expected range already used.

Exit Strategy: Standard FVGC exit (1R TP, SL at swing). No modification needed — the filter is pre-trade context only.
frequency: ~124 trades over dataset (high VIXY days only, W1 entries, <30% range used)

name: MACD
description: At the moment of FVGC entry, check the MACD(12,26,9) histogram on the 5-minute chart. Only take the trade if the histogram is expanding in the trade direction AND on the correct side of zero (strict filter). This captures real-time momentum state that static pre-market factors miss. Confirmed trades jump from 51.7% → 61.1% WR and baseline PF 1.09 → 2.05 with runner management. Contracting histogram trades (25% WR, PF 0.33) should be skipped entirely. Shorts outperform longs across all variants. Runner profile is strong — median 2R arrival is only 10 minutes from entry.
pre_market_conditions: None specific — this is a pure intraday entry filter. Apply on top of any existing pre-market bias. Works across all macro windows and gap directions.
action_plan:
At the FVGC entry bar, switch to the 5-minute chart and check MACD(12,26,9) histogram:

LONG — both required:
• Histogram is positive (bar is above zero line)
• Current bar histogram > previous bar histogram (expanding upward)

SHORT — both required:
• Histogram is negative (bar is below zero line)
• Current bar histogram < previous bar histogram (expanding downward — more negative)

If either condition fails → skip the trade.

Best setups (>2 PF with Strategy G runner):
• Short + IFVG: 70.6% WR, PF 3.07 (~0.4/wk)
• Short + Protected Swing: 65.4% WR, PF 2.42 (~0.7/wk)
• Short + BOS: 63.4% WR, PF 2.33 (~1.1/wk)
• Long + IFVG: 62.5% WR, PF 2.26 (~0.4/wk)
• Long + No FVG: 63.1% WR, PF 2.14 (~1.7/wk)

Histogram magnitude note: medium-sized histogram (abs value roughly 4–9 pts on NQ) has the highest WR at 65.6%. Very small histograms (<4 pts) = weakest confirmation at 56% WR.

Exit Strategy: Strategy G — Scale-Out Runner (PF 2.05, 89.3% positive months across 28-month sample):
• At +1R: exit 33% of position, move stop to breakeven
• At +2R: exit another 33%, move stop to +1R
• At +3R: exit final 34%, or trail further if momentum still expanding

Time guide (based on 30s-bar data, confirmed trades):
• 1R reached at median 3.5 min from entry
• 2R reached at median 10 min from entry
• 3R reached at median 18.5 min from entry
• If 2R not reached within ~20 min, tighten trail to +0.5R

Alternative for higher raw PF: Fixed 3R (PF 2.43) — but higher monthly variance.
Conservative fallback: 50% at 1R + 50% trail to 2R or +0.5R (PF 1.98, lower stress).
frequency: ~4.3 qualified setups/week (>2 PF combos); ~7.7 MACD-confirmed/week total

name: Thursday Inside Value Area
description: On Thursdays, when the FVGC entry price falls inside the prior day's Value Area (between VAL and VAH), the model produces 73.7% WR and 2.89 PF on 76 trades. Highly significant (p=0.0002). Neither Thursday alone nor Inside VA alone is significant — the interaction is the edge. Thursdays see institutional rebalancing ahead of Friday expiration; inside the VA signals acceptance/balance, so FVGC entries catch clean rotations.
pre_market_conditions: Check calendar: is it Thursday? Night before, pull up prior day's volume profile on TradingView. Note VAH and VAL prices.
action_plan:
FVGC entry price must fall between prior day's VAL and VAH (inside the 70% value area). Long or short — both work equally (73.8% / 73.5% WR). All macro windows MW1-MW3 are valid.

Exit Strategy: Primary: BE@1R → 2R — move stop to breakeven at +1R, hold for 2R target. 50% WR, 3.80 PF, +0.74R EV, 71% months profitable. Conservative alt: Fixed 1R (73.7% WR, +0.47R EV). Aggressive alt: BE@1R → 2.5R on bearish 930 candle days (+0.86R EV).
frequency: ~37/yr (~3.1/mo) — Thursdays only, so roughly 1 most Thursdays (sometimes multiple per Thursday). 21 months with data, only 3 losing months.

name: 15m FVG Breakout Continuation
description: Price breaks through an unmitigated 15-minute FVG — the gap fails to hold. An opposing FVG that was supporting the prior structure gets inverted, confirming the break is real. Then a FVGC signal fires in the breakout direction (continuation, not reversal). This is a momentum play: when 15m structure fails, the move runs hard. Median MFE 8.7R. Only works on 15m FVGs — tested all level types, nothing else comes close.
pre_market_conditions: Identify unmitigated 15-minute FVGs on the chart. These are potential breakout levels if they fail to hold.
action_plan:
1) Price breaks through a 15m FVG — closes on the far side (non-reclaiming). 2) Within 10 bars (30s TF), an opposing-direction FVG created before the break gets inverted (close crosses its far boundary). 3) First FVGC signal in the SAME direction as the break fires within 40 bars of the inversion. Entry must be 09:30–10:15 NY. KEY DIFFERENCE from reversal study: trade direction matches the break direction, not opposite.

Exit Strategy: BE@1R → TP 3R (or hold to 5R: PF 8.33)
frequency: ~23/yr (~1.9/mo) | ~1 every 10 days (median) | longest typical wait 38 days. NOTE: play status REJECTED — DO NOT TRADE.

wr_base: 62.2% base, 64.0% with not-BOS filter, 75% with Prior Day draw

action_plan:

name: M1 Short — Confluence Model
description: Short FVGC in 9:30–9:45 with ≥2 of 7 pre-market + 9:30 confluences AND no hard vetoes (vixy_low, dow_monday). Confluences: gap_large_down, prior_day_weak, is_fomc_week, vixy_high, dow_friday, bear_930, c930_body_top_q. 2-tier UPGRADED to full-size runner (was light TP@1R). OOS-validated (Oct 2025-Mar 2026, n=13, 76.9% WR).

action_plan:
FVGC short fires 9:30-9:45. Skip if protected_swing variant. Count 7 confluences, apply tier table for sizing. 2+ = full size runner. 4+ = max size runner.

Exit Strategy: Runner mode at 2+ conf. Recommended: 1/3 @ 1R + 1/3 @ 2R + 1/3 rides to 5R with NO BE on runner (+0.77R EV/trade). Never BE@1R on this play.

name: FVGC Off of 930 Candle
description: ARCHIVED — Absorbed into W1 Short Confluence Model. The 930 candle play without the 15m FVG gate = 49.1% WR (break even). The gate explains the edge, not the 930 candle itself. Bear 930 is now confluence #2 in the unified 6-factor model.

name: FVGC To Opening Range H/L
description: 1m FVGC entries after 9:45 ET, target 2R, hold original SL. Base play 8yr-validated: n=405, 47.4% WR, PF 1.81 at 2R, EV +0.388R per trade. IS≈OOS (drift 0.02). Bootstrap 95% CI on PF [1.47, 2.21]. Kill switch: OR > 150pts (PF 0.92). Sweet spot: OR 60-100pt + long direction = PF 2.36 (premium A+ cell). The 'play dies on OR sweep' rule is intuitive but permutation-test shows it ≈ noise — the edge is in the base FVGC model + 2R hold, not the sweep gate.
pre_market_conditions: None required. This is an intraday-only setup. OR is set at 9:45 ET.
action_plan:
1. After 9:45 ET (OR set). 2. Compute OR range (OR.H - OR.L). If > 150pts → SKIP (kill switch). 3. FVGC entry forms on 1m chart. 4. Prefer LONG entries (PF 2.02 vs short 1.60). 5. OR range sweet spot 60-100pt (PF 2.03), acceptable 30-100pt. 6. R-to-OR between 0.25 and 1.0 (sweet spot 0.5-0.75 = PF 2.67). Skip if R-to-OR > 1.5. 7. SKIP ifvg variant (PF 1.52, weakest). 8. Target 2R, hold original SL.

Exit Strategy: Target 2R, hold original SL. NEVER move to breakeven. Validated on 8 years (2018-2026): IS PF 1.77, OOS PF 1.82 — essentially identical. 1m timeframe wins cross-TF stability (drift 0.02 vs 30s 0.40, 2m 0.48, 3m 0.78).
frequency: Tier A (premium, 2x): ~8/yr (~0.7/mo) | median 26d between trades | longest typical wait 110d. Base play (1x): ~24/yr (~2.0/mo) | median 9d between trades | longest typical wait 36d. Combined: ~32 non-vetoed/yr (~1 every 7-10 days).
